newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.2800/2900 to the dollar in a volatile session on Wednesday, following Tuesday's devaluation, dealers said.

The taka was quoted in a wide range at 43.20/30 per dollar in early trade but edged up by midday on bank demand for a large volume of the U.S. dollar for import payments. "The market was volatile. Players watched the impact of yesterday's devaluation (of taka)," said one dealer. Call money rates were traded at 7.5 to 8.0 percent, slightly down from Tuesday's 8.0-8.5 percent.
